properties.name: memoryos.chat.provider.api-key
properties.description: Credential for the configured Chat provider. Inject from the runtime secret store.

properties.name: memoryos.chat.provider.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the supported OpenAI protocol endpoint.

properties.name: memoryos.chat.provider.input-price-per-million
properties.description: Input price in USD per million tokens; -1 means unknown.

properties.name: memoryos.chat.provider.output-price-per-million
properties.description: Output price in USD per million tokens; -1 means unknown.

properties.name: memoryos.chat.execution.maintenance-interval
properties.description: Interval for pending terminal persistence and stale deadline reconciliation.
